images.title: Opposite sides of a parallelogram are equal
images.purpose: Shows parallelogram ABCD cut by diagonal BD into two congruent triangles, so CB = 5 cm and CD = 4 cm.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One large parallelogram in the centre cut by one diagonal into two lightly shaded triangles, with all four side lengths shown.
images.exact_structure: One parallelogram ABCD in dark outline: AB is the horizontal bottom side, A at bottom left and B at bottom right; AD leans to the right at 30° above AB and is longer than AB in the ratio 5 to 4; D is top left and C top right. The diagonal BD is a dark line. Triangle ABD (left) is lightly filled teal (#0072B2) and triangle CDB (right) is lightly filled amber (#E69F00). Labels beside the sides: 4 cm under AB, 5 cm left of AD, 4 cm above DC and 5 cm right of CB, so equal sides face each other. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A diagonal splits a parallelogram into two congruent triangles, so its opposite sides are equal.
images.description: Shows parallelogram ABCD cut by diagonal BD into two congruent triangles, so CB = 5 cm and CD = 4 cm.

image_decisions.why: The two shaded congruent triangles with matching side lengths make the property and its reason visible.
